_comment: USAspending recipient names tied to a NYSE/Nasdaq-listed parent for the Federal contracts panel on /bottlenecks/capex (#563 D5). Each alias carries its basis. USAspending's own parent field is NOT trusted on its own: it is stale for several recipients (Sikorsky under RTX, Amentum under AECOM, V2X under ITT), so every alias here is stated explicitly. 'exclusions' are names that must not map, with the reason. Recipients not listed here map only by an exact normalised name match to a NYSE or Nasdaq company in data/sec/company-tickers.json; anything else stays unmatched.

aliases.name: RAYTHEON COMPANY
aliases.basis: Raytheon Company is a subsidiary of RTX Corporation

aliases.name: SIKORSKY AIRCRAFT CORPORATION
aliases.basis: Sikorsky is a Lockheed Martin subsidiary (acquired 2015); USAspending lists a stale RTX parent

aliases.name: NATIONAL STEEL AND SHIPBUILDING COMPANY
aliases.basis: General Dynamics NASSCO, a General Dynamics subsidiary

aliases.name: GENERAL DYNAMICS OTS (WILKES BARRE), LLC
aliases.basis: General Dynamics Ordnance and Tactical Systems subsidiary

aliases.name: NORTHROP GRUMMAN SYSTEMS CORPORATION
aliases.basis: Northrop Grumman operating subsidiary; USAspending lists more than one parent for it

aliases.name: HUNTINGTON INGALLS INCORPORATED
aliases.basis: Huntington Ingalls Industries operating company; USAspending lists a subsidiary as parent

aliases.name: AMENTUM SERVICES, INC.
aliases.basis: Amentum Holdings subsidiary (listed 2024); USAspending lists a stale AECOM parent

aliases.name: V2X SYSTEMS LLC
aliases.basis: V2X, Inc. subsidiary; USAspending lists a stale ITT parent

aliases.name: NATIONAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING SOLUTIONS OF SANDIA, LLC
aliases.basis: Wholly owned Honeywell subsidiary that operates Sandia National Laboratories

exclusions.name: SAVANNAH RIVER NUCLEAR SOLUTIONS LLC
exclusions.reason: Joint venture of several companies; not attributed to one

exclusions.name: MISSION SUPPORT & TEST SERVICES LLC
exclusions.reason: Joint venture of several companies; not attributed to one

exclusions.name: CONSOLIDATED NUCLEAR SECURITY, LLC
exclusions.reason: Joint venture of several companies; not attributed to one

exclusions.name: BELL BOEING JOINT PROJECT OFFICE
exclusions.reason: Joint programme of Bell Textron and Boeing; not attributed to one

exclusions.name: PANTEXAS DETERRENCE, LLC
exclusions.reason: Joint venture of several companies; not attributed to one
